state_contract.restore: Assign deep-copied .state to original cache instances; target/draft list and cache object identity retained. No recurrent trim or inferred missing setter.
invariants: Full k+1 outputs retain target verified prefix; final corrective output remains unconsumed.
Full accept leaves final accepted draft input pending, then batches it with the next gold input.
Partial rejection, length truncation and generator.close restore target then replay old gold plus actual yielded outputs except the final output.
Draft is retained only when its consumed prefix exactly matches actual outputs; otherwise restore and replay old pending plus actual consumed prefix.
Zero budget does not execute draft; pending work accumulates until a positive-budget cycle.
All replay state tensors are mx.eval-ed before complete-cycle timing closes; snapshots, output consumer and recovery cost are included.
A positive-budget pre-yield forward or profiling-hook error restores available snapshots and aborts incomplete DS schedule state without invented acceptance feedback.
Zero-budget pre-yield device failure has no snapshot; request-local mutable caches are discarded by engine. No successful request/cache continuation is claimed after a failed forward.

Engine checks cancellation on every yielded token and closes generator; adapter itself checks cancellation between cycles. Existing prompt snapshots are cloned and never mutated by a cancelled request.
